mapper.select: SELECT b.user_id, b.task_id, b.binding_id, b.agent_id, b.framework_session_id, b.native_event_cursor FROM sq_runtime_binding b LEFT JOIN sq_goal_task t ON t.user_id = b.user_id AND t.task_id = b.task_id LEFT JOIN sq_response_execution r ON r.user_id = b.user_id AND r.binding_id = b.binding_id WHERE b.next_projection_at <= #{now} AND ((t.task_id IS NOT NULL AND t.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'RECOVERY_BLOCKED')) OR (r.execution_id IS NOT NULL AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_command c WHERE c.user_id = b.user_id AND c.binding_id = b.binding_id AND c.status IN ('DELIVERED', 'APPLIED')) AND (b.role = 'MASTER' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sq_worker_job j WHERE j.user_id = b.user_id AND j.binding_id = b.binding_id AND j.status IN ('READY', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_INPUT', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'RECONCILING', 'CANCELLING'))) ORDER BY b.next_projection_at, b.id LIMIT 20
SELECT native_event_cursor FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_runtime_binding SET next_projection_at = #{nextPollAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId}
UPDATE sq_goal_task SET event_seq = event_seq + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT event_seq FROM sq_goal_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_goal_task SET status = 'RUNNING', version = version + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE sq_command SET status = 'APPLIED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND action IN ('RESUME', 'RESPOND') AND status = 'DELIVERED'
